text:
Recommended protocol: retain each model’s binary hit per validation user; compute macro HR@10 as the mean of four category means. For paired bootstrap uncertainty, resample 200 users with replacement within each category, using identical resampled indices across models; repeat 10,000 times and report the 95% percentile interval for the macro difference plus category differences. Resample users, not candidates. This adapts [paired bootstrap comparison](https://aclanthology.org/W04-3250.pdf); uncertainty is conditional on fixed negatives and training seed, excluding training variability. Sampled-ranking results cannot establish full-catalog superiority ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).

Repeated validation selection creates optimism; bootstrapping the selected winner does not remove it ([Cawley–Talbot](https://jmlr.csail.mit.edu/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). Predeclare variants, checkpoint opportunities, and selection rules; log every attempted configuration. Select by the required macro HR@10, describe small gains as uncertain, and reserve held-out testing for the frozen winner. Compare primarily at equal cumulative GPU-seconds, including diagnostics, debugging, failed runs, and tuning; concurrent trials add their GPU time. Also report matched-epoch results to distinguish optimization exposure from computational efficiency. Search-budget reporting matters ([Dodge et al.](https://aclanthology.org/D19-1224/)).

Minimal proposed design: baseline RecHarness SASRec; baseline with only a replacement loss, keeping training negatives fixed; baseline with only an explicit recency weighting; baseline with only a recurrent sequence component. Keep preprocessing seed=0, training seed=42, all categories, routing, and evaluator unchanged. Define recurrence explicitly; if it means repeat-item counts, previously seen-item bonuses cannot help unseen-item candidates directly. Allocate, for example, 8,000 GPU-seconds per arm and retain 11,200 for contingencies and confirmation. Use the 200-epoch baseline where affordable, plus shared compute checkpoints. These are proposed controls, not established empirical findings.
